title: TikTok: What happens if you stop sleeping, hour by hour (Video 6)

lines.text: This is what happens to your body if you stop sleeping. Hour by hour.
After sixteen hours, your focus starts to slip.
After nineteen hours, you react like someone with a blood alcohol level of 0.05 percent.
After a full day, it is like 0.1 percent. Drunk, by the law of most countries.
The record? A teenager stayed awake for eleven days. He started to hallucinate.
So how long have you been awake right now?
